# glinet_wireless_radio (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt `wifi-device` radio. The resource adopts an existing radio section; it never creates or deletes radio hardware. Keep a direct wired management path for channel or width changes.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_wireless_radio.wifi_2g
  id = "mt798611"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireless_radio" "wifi_2g" {
  device  = "mt798611"
  channel = "auto"
  htmode  = "HE40"
  txpower = 100
  country = "JP"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) Channel number or `auto`. The router's regulatory domain remains authoritative.
- `device` (String) UCI `wifi-device` section name.

### Optional

- `country` (String) Two-letter regulatory country code, such as `JP`. When omitted, the current value is preserved.
- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. This resource preserves the adopted `wifi-device` section; `forget` is required and `delete` is rejected.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the radio.
- `htmode` (String) Channel width and generation, such as `HE40` or `HE80`. Accepted values are `HT20`, `HT40`, `VHT20`, `VHT40`, `VHT80`, `VHT160`, `HE20`, `HE40`, `HE80`, and `HE160`.
- `txpower` (Number) Transmit power percentage, 0–100.

### Read-Only

- `band` (String) Radio band reported by the router, such as `2g` or `5g`.
- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
